title: devexp-standup-2026-04-22
content:
Developer Experience — Standup notes
Date: 2026-04-22
Attendees: Evan Chen (owner), Aisha Kapoor, Priya Singh, Mateo Alvarez, Lucy Park, Jordan Miles
Duration: 25m (standing)
---
Quick agenda: SDK release candidate status, docs deploy + search, sample apps (chatbot + embeddings demo), quickstart templates, CI flakiness update, action items.

Updates
- Aisha (SDK):
  - Finished integration tests for Python SDK v0.9.0-rc.2. Most breaking changes documented in PR 482, still need to finalize streaming client semantics.
  - Observed two test failures on arm64 runners (serialization edge-case). Root cause looks like ordering nondeterminism in the streaming buffer; working with infra to repro.
  - Plan: cut RC3 after CI stability and publish release notes.

- Priya (Docs):
  - Docs PR 127 (new quickstart flow + examples) is staged; build failed on netlify preview due to search indexing error (internal token expired).
  - Added draft migration notes for function calling examples (need review from the SDK owners on snippet accuracy).
  - Request: ask Aisha to confirm code snippets for streaming vs polling examples by EOD Thu.

- Mateo (Samples):
  - Embeddings demo updated to new batch API; sample fails when batch size > 32 on older GPU instances (OOB memory). Added guard & informative error message.
  - Chatbot sample: integrating function/tool calling example; hit formatting mismatch with docs snippets (Priya aware).
  - Will run a quick smoke test across dedicated and hosted endpoints tomorrow.

- Lucy (Quickstarts):
  - Rewrote quickstart templates to focus on 5-min first-run experience. Removed advanced routing section temporarily to reduce cognitive load.
  - Need 1-2 screenshots from the Console team (Jordan to follow up).

- Jordan (CI/Infra):
  - CI flakiness: intermittent macOS runners failing at test setup -> suspected flaky caching of wheel artifacts. Rolling back a recent cache plugin update on the flaky pool to test.
  - Netlify token rotation caused docs preview failures; rotating tokens and adding alerting for future expirations.

Blockers / Risks
- SDK arm64 test nondeterminism blocking RC3 (Aisha, JIRA-DEVEXP-312).
- Docs preview/search failures preventing copyediting of quickstarts before release (Priya, JIRA-DEVEXP-319).
- Embeddings sample memory issue on older GPUs — may need guidance in docs about recommended instance types (Mateo).

Decisions made
- Hold v0.9.0 final release until SDK RC3 has stable CI across amd64 and arm64 (target next Tue).
- Quickstart public rollout will be gated on docs preview stability and at least one successful smoke test on Dedicated (smoke test owner: Mateo).

Action items (owner, due)
- Aisha: reproduce arm64 serialization failure and open a detailed issue with minimal repro + temporary unit test (due: 2026-04-24).
- Jordan: rollback cache plugin on macOS pool and monitor for flakiness; report status in #devexp-ci (due: 2026-04-23).
- Priya: fix netlify preview token, re-run builds, and merge PR 127 after snippet confirmations (due: 2026-04-23).
- Mateo: run cross-environment smoke tests for samples (Hosted, Dedicated) and upload results + logs to Confluence quickstarts page (due: 2026-04-24).
- Lucy: add simplified Console screenshots to quickstart templates; coordinate with Jordan for access (due: 2026-04-24).
- Evan: draft release notes outline and coordinate canary rollout plan for SDK v0.9.0 (due: 2026-04-24).

Notes to self / follow-ups
- Consider adding a nightly arm64 CI lane for SDK to catch nondeterministic failures earlier.
- We should add a short section in the quickstarts about recommended instance types for sample runs (memory guidance).
- Follow up with Console team to get stable screenshot export workflow.

Parking lot / Questions
- Do we want to keep advanced routing in the main quickstart or move it as an "advanced" appendix? (proposal: move to appendix to keep first-run <5m).
- How aggressive should we be about backporting SDK changes to the 0.8.x branch for customers on Dedicated? Evan to propose branching strategy.

Next meeting focus (2026-04-29):
- SDK RC3 status and release timeline
- Results of sample smoke tests across deployment modes
- Quickstart public rollout checklist (docs + screenshots + analytics)

End of notes.
